services.value: The company provides biological testing and laboratory analysis for environmental samples, including pathogen analysis such as Cryptosporidium and Giardia (EPA 1623.1), enteroviruses (EPA/600/R-95/178 and EPA1615), Legionella water analysis, and other pathogen and indicator testing (e.g., fecal coliform, Salmonella, enteric viruses, helminth ova). It also performs water purifier/filter efficacy testing and biosolids/solids analysis for Class A biosolids using EPA Principal Biosolids Guidance (EPA/625/R-92/013), as well as antimicrobial and disinfection efficacy testing and microbiological consulting/training.
